zh.title: 美國將移交三架 King Air 給菲律賓海巡署　兩架搭載海上監偵系統
zh.summary: 美方將提供三架 King Air 渦槳機，其中兩架依 3,900 萬美元合約整合情監偵套件，並包含訓練。
body: 美國將向菲律賓海岸警衛隊移交三架 King Air 渦輪螺旋槳飛機，用於海域態勢感知。USNI News 報導，這項移交安排已於 2026 年 2 月由美國國防部官員與菲律賓海巡署確認。
美國國防部於 9 月 28 日授予 Technology Service Corporation 一份價值 3,900 萬美元的合約，採購並整合情監偵套件至 King Air 350ER。三架飛機中有兩架將安裝相關硬體與軟體。
合約也包含人員訓練。這批飛機可擴大菲律賓海巡署的空中海域監視能力，但報導未提供完整交付時程。

en.title: US to transfer three King Air aircraft to Philippine Coast Guard, two with maritime ISR systems
en.summary: Two of the three turboprops are to receive intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance kits under a $39 million contract that also includes training.
body: The United States plans to transfer three King Air turboprops to the Philippine Coast Guard for maritime domain awareness. USNI News reports that the transfer was finalized in February 2026 by US Defense Department and Philippine Coast Guard officials.

On September 28, the Pentagon awarded Technology Service Corporation a $39 million contract to procure and integrate intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance kits on King Air 350ER aircraft. Two of the three aircraft are to receive the related hardware and software.
The contract also includes personnel training. The aircraft would expand the coast guard's airborne maritime-surveillance capacity, although a complete delivery schedule was not disclosed.

facts.claim: The United States plans to transfer three King Air turboprops to the Philippine Coast Guard for maritime domain awareness.
A $39 million contract awarded on September 28 covers ISR-kit procurement and integration for King Air 350ER aircraft.
Two of the three aircraft are to receive ISR hardware and software, and the contract includes training.
